mus_ref_a.png:
Character design sheet for Mus, a small round turtle disciple of the Turtle-Shell school (a friend of the hero cat in the reference): a RED headband with two long trailing tails, a conical straw hat hanging on the back by a red cord, cloth leg wraps on the lower legs, a domed shell with a carved clan emblem (a hexagon inside a circle) on the back, big round eyes with slightly droopy sleepy eyelids but a warm confident smile. Look A, the chubby ninja apprentice: extra round body, olive-green skin, a short moss-green sleeveless dojo jacket tied with a rope belt, the shell polished like dark lacquered wood with the emblem in gold, front pose with both little fists raised like a boxer, cheerful.

MATCH THE REFERENCE IMAGE EXACTLY IN STYLE: it is the character sheet of the game's hero cat. Same thick black outlines, same flat colours with soft shading, same chibi proportions (head as big as the body, stubby limbs, big glossy eyes with white highlights, blush marks), same sticker-like cute energy. The turtle is that cat's friend in the same game, so they must look like they were drawn by the same artist.
Show the SAME character three times side by side on one canvas: full body front view standing in a lively pose, full body side view facing RIGHT, and a big face close-up. Draw everything SOLID and OPAQUE. Nothing else in the picture: no text, no letters, no labels, no watermark, no border, no ground.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. The turtle's skin must be olive or moss green (never the pure chroma green).
Output 1024x1024 PNG. Save the image as mus_ref_a.png in the current directory and report the path.
